from solution import get_Position
import inspect


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Example get_Position([2,5,4],3,2) == 2."""
    result = get_Position([2, 5, 4], 3, 2)
    assert result == 2  # expected literal 2 from issue example


def test_issue_example_repeatable():
    """Repeated calls with get_Position([2,5,4],3,2) == 2 give same position."""
    first = get_Position([2, 5, 4], 3, 2)
    second = get_Position([2, 5, 4], 3, 2)
    assert first == second == 2  # both must equal literal 2 from issue


def test_issue_single_element_position():
    """With one element the last removed position must be that element's position."""
    result = get_Position([9], 1, 1)
    assert result in (0, 1)  # literals 0 = 0-indexed pos, 1 = 1-indexed pos


def test_issue_single_element_other_value():
    """With one element a different value still has only one possible position."""
    result = get_Position([99], 1, 1)
    assert result in (0, 1)  # literals 0 = 0-indexed pos, 1 = 1-indexed pos


def test_issue_two_elements_m1_in_range():
    """A position for n=2 must lie within valid positions 0..2."""
    result = get_Position([10, 20], 2, 1)
    assert 0 <= result <= 2  # bounds 0 min and 2 = n = 2 max 1-indexed


def test_issue_two_elements_m2_in_range():
    """A position for n=2 with m=2 must lie within valid positions 0..2."""
    result = get_Position([10, 20], 2, 2)
    assert 0 <= result <= 2  # bounds 0 min and 2 = n = 2 max 1-indexed


def test_issue_five_elements_in_range():
    """A position for n=5 must lie within valid positions 0..5."""
    result = get_Position([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 5, 3)
    assert 0 <= result <= 5  # bounds 0 min and 5 = n = 5 max 1-indexed


def test_issue_same_array_other_m_in_range():
    """A position for [2,5,4] with n=3 and other m must still be 0..3."""
    result = get_Position([2, 5, 4], 3, 1)
    assert 0 <= result <= 3  # bounds 0 min and 3 = n = 3 max 1-indexed


def test_contract_takes_three_arguments():
    """Public interface get_Position(a, n, m) takes three arguments."""
    sig = inspect.signature(get_Position)
    assert len(sig.parameters) == 3  # 3 params: a, n, m so len == 3


def test_contract_callable():
    """Module solution exposes callable get_Position as documented."""
    assert callable(get_Position) is True  # expected literal True


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Position of the last removed element is an integer position."""
    result = get_Position([2, 5, 4], 3, 2)
    assert isinstance(result, int) is True  # expected literal True; example value is 2
